plugins.name: usage-bar
plugins.description: 5h/7d rate limits with pace markers, session tokens and cost: above the prompt, or in a /usage-bar pane; with theme-studio installed, dropdowns to pick its look and mode

plugins.name: theme-arctic
plugins.description: Cool blue-gray ice in both modes, with a soft frosted gradient behind the chat

plugins.name: theme-forest
plugins.description: Moss and fern greens in both modes, with a radial glade behind the chat

plugins.name: theme-night-sky
plugins.description: Dark only: a twinkling starfield with shooting stars behind the conversation

plugins.name: theme-ocean-tide
plugins.description: Dark only: slow rolling waves under a moonlit sea behind the conversation

plugins.name: theme-paper
plugins.description: Warm paper by day, lamp-lit paper by night (desktop and mobile apps)

plugins.name: theme-studio
plugins.description: Four premium looks (Alpine, Seaside, Glass, Plaster): high-res photographic, painted, abstract and minimal backdrops, each with day and night versions that switch by local time; pick with /look
